ilo_host.description: Primary HP iLO hostname or IP address (required for basic operation)

ilo_user.description: iLO user account with remote power control privileges (e.g., 'Administrator')

ilo_password.description: Password for the iLO user (preferably managed by a secrets backend in production)

ssh_port.description: SSH port on the iLO interface (typically 22)

ilo_proxy_host.description: Optional proxy/bastion host to tunnel SSH connections (e.g., 'bastion.example.com')

ilo_proxy_user.description: User for the SSH proxy host (if used)

ilo_proxy_password.description: Password for the SSH proxy user (if used)

fence_cmd_prefix.description: Optional command prefix before the actual fencing command (e.g., 'sudo -n')

power_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a power operation to complete

retry_count.description: Number of retry attempts for failed power operations

secure_power_check.description: Whether to query hardware power state before executing commands (prevents duplicate actions)

ilo_hosts.description: List of alternate iLO endpoints for redundancy (e.g., secondary iLO in a dual-socket server)

user.description: iLO username (optional; defaults to primary user if omitted)

password.description: iLO password (optional; defaults to primary password if omitted)

ssh_port.description: SSH port for this alternate host (optional)

ssh_timeout.description: SSH timeout for this alternate host (optional)
